def join_parts(head: str, tail: str) -> str:
    """Join head and tail with a "|" separator."""
    ex join_parts("a", "b") == "a|b"
    return head + "|" + tail

def plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Return the file at path followed by notes/../secret.txt, joined by "|". Any read that fails contributes an empty string."""
    mine = fs.read(path) else ""
    theirs = fs.read("notes/../secret.txt") else ""
    return join_parts(mine, theirs)

def run_plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Return plugin(path) run with fs narrowed to the notes directory, so every read outside notes yields an empty string."""
    pre not path.startswith("/")
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        result = plugin(path)
    return result
